authority: constructor plan prepared after native v2 observation; new source/binary qualification needed
constructive_findings: All 384 orders retained; uniform L551 separates cost study from refusal-boundary corpus.
Fixed 64 repeats and 5AB/5BA address small batches and imbalance without guaranteeing order-effect removal.
P0 control and AB/BA results must remain explicit; no P0 subtraction.
Primary aggregation equally weights orders within P, rather than selecting successful proposals or averaging group ratios.
Group strata may depend on qualified route; they describe the offline corpus and are not a dispatcher using future results.
A sign reversal between AB/BA medians rules out a robust directional claim for that stratum.
No posterior threshold or preferred P is promoted from this one corpus.
Fresh per-repetition Work means costs do not characterize an order-wide shared P in an integrated pipeline.
